The review does not mention Krumholz & Matzner 2009, radiation pressure, photoionization, or challenge the specific cited claim about feedback in young dense clusters. No source-specific contradiction of the reversed citation claim is flagged.

The reviewer discusses the paper's overall findings on feedback coupling but never mentions the specific citation to Krumholz (2009) or the directional claim about radiation pressure in the introduction.
